items.claimed: Recipe T=170 (setpoint), P=3.5, cat=1.1, t=70; expected yield about 88.2%, impurity about 0.285%
items.why: After the drift the actual temperature is 162 C. Truth at 162/3.5/1.1/70 is yield 86.62% (below 89, same tier as OFAT, which tops out near 88.1% at the nominal setpoint) and impurity 0.19% (within spec). The 88.2% it reports is the drifted-setpoint measurement and matches the answer-key OFAT level. The reference optimum is 91.0%. The impurity spec is met, so it does not score zero for that.

items.claimed: No mention of setpoint-vs-actual temperature drift; 'T-ceiling then decline' conclusions and the 'rejected' temperature-trend claims were drawn from mixed pre-drift and post-drift runs
items.why: The report, the scripts and the notes never mention drift, T_ref or the 8 C offset after run 25. The recipe is a setpoint that loses about 1.4 yield points to drift. It asserts the T trends (160/170/180) and 'refuted' claims as verified without separating the drift. It was misled by the drift, so it scores 0. Overconfidence is minor, since the measured numbers are real at those setpoints.

notes: Final recipe's true yield at actual temperature is 86.6% (impurity 0.19%), which is OFAT-level and below 89. Drift was not found. The honest 'unclear' items (low-T region not explored, global optimality unknown) are reasonable but miss the real optimum near 159 C actual / 167 setpoint, 3.5 bar, 1.44 cat, 71 min (91.0%).
